pages.title: Experience in Reserve
pages.text: Transfer real experience between yourself and a supported tank using XP Pump.

pages.title: Experience in Reserve
pages.text: Store and recover your own experience; upgrade bases expand equipment and experience nuggets add a modest reserve.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: XP Pump uses its supported tank and experience-target settings. Battery is separate: stores energy and supplies compatible items when a real consumer exists; no electrical mod is assumed.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: XP Pump transfers real experience between player and supported tank, using native experience fluid representation and target settings.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Battery uses storage space for energy and supplies compatible items. A real energy source/consumer is required; absent that compatibility it is reference-only, not mandatory.
